scripts.title: Welcome to Sacred Ground
scripts.spoken:
Hi — I’m Deneene, and this is Sacred Ground in Arlington Heights.

We’re a crystal shop and a healing space… a place to breathe, browse, and come as you are.

Come say hello. The door is open.
scripts.caption: Welcome to Sacred Ground — crystals, healing, and a warm seat in Arlington Heights. shopsacredground.com · 847-749-3922

scripts.title: Free Community Meditation (Tuesday)
scripts.spoken:
Tuesdays at Sacred Ground, we gather for Free Community Meditation.

No experience needed. Just show up, settle in, and let the room hold you for a little while.

We’d love to sit with you. Details are on our site — shopsacredground.com.
scripts.caption: Free Community Meditation — Tuesdays at Sacred Ground. Come as you are. shopsacredground.com

scripts.title: Shop vibe — soft light, real shelves
scripts.spoken:
If you’ve been craving a quiet place that still feels alive… this is it.

Cases of crystals, warm light, and room to wander without rushing.

Come browse. Stay as long as you need. We’ll leave the light on.
scripts.caption: Soft light, real shelves, and room to breathe — Sacred Ground, Arlington Heights. shopsacredground.com

scripts.title: Observatory — Beneath the Surface
scripts.spoken:
Every day, our Observatory offers a quiet look Beneath the Surface —

a little insight for whoever needs it.

Peek when you have a moment. It changes every day.
shopsacredground.com/sacred-ground-observatory
scripts.caption: A quiet daily look Beneath the Surface — Sacred Ground Observatory. https://shopsacredground.com/sacred-ground-observatory/

scripts.title: Come as you are
scripts.spoken:
You don’t have to know what you’re looking for.

You can come for a crystal, a reading, a class — or just to feel a little more grounded.

Come as you are. We’ll keep a seat warm.
scripts.caption: Come as you are — Sacred Ground, Arlington Heights. shopsacredground.com · 847-749-3922

scripts.title: Readings — soft invite
scripts.spoken:
When you’re ready for a little clarity, our practitioners are here —

tarot, energy work, and gentle guidance, offered with care.

Browse the calendar on our site, and book what feels right.
We’ll meet you there.
scripts.caption: Readings and energy work at Sacred Ground — book what feels right. shopsacredground.com
